result.summary: This commercial intersection features embedded trolley tracks that present a significant trip hazard and complicate the pedestrian crossing experience. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the environment is degraded by faded pavement markings and wide crossing distances.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway create a significant trip hazard for pedestrians and a slip hazard for all road users, especially when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Running through the center of the roadway and across the intersection area.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk paint is heavily worn, making the designated crossing area less visible to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and the stopped bus near the corner block the view between pedestrians at the curb and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the bus and parked cars along the curb.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the intersection with continental-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness of the crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features wide roadways with visible trolley tracks and significantly degraded pavement. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, there are no marked crosswalks or dedicated pedestrian signals, creating a high-exposure environment for people crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing locations at a signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement and Tracks
hazards.description: Uneven road surface and embedded trolley tracks create tripping hazards and difficult footing for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface throughout the foreground and intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large vehicles parked near the corner block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection near the FedEx truck

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane roadway with significant pavement degradation and a complete lack of marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present, they are narrow and cluttered, and pedestrians are observed crossing the street without any dedicated infrastructure or protection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians are crossing a wide multi-lane road without any painted crosswalks to indicate their right-of-way to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground where a pedestrian is crossing the street.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily cracked and patched, creating uneven surfaces for both vehicles and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at the signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The intersection features high pedestrian activity in a commercial setting but lacks marked crosswalks and clear crossing paths. Significant obstructions from construction barriers, street vendors, and poor pavement quality create a cluttered and potentially hazardous environment for walkers.

hazards.name: Construction Obstructions
hazards.description: Orange plastic barriers and cones block the natural pedestrian path at the corner, forcing people into the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings define where pedestrians should cross, reducing driver awareness.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt surfaces present tripping hazards for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Wayfinding during Construction
interventions.description: Ensure a clear, ADA-compliant path is maintained through or around the construction zone.
